facts.business: ARSS Infrastructure Projects Limited is an infrastructure construction company engaged in executing construction contracts and infrastructure projects.

auditor.name: A D V AND CO LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Non-compliance with IND AS 115 for revenue recognition on construction contracts; 2) Recognition of arbitration claims of Rs 70,831.96 Lakhs as income and receivables despite uncertain outcome; 3) Classification of loan from Ocean Capital Market Limited as secured borrowing with 9% interest accrual without security creation, NCLT plan approval, or related party transaction approvals. Emphasis of matter on CIRP completion and Resolution Plan implementation approved by NCLT on 29th August 2025 in favor of Ocean Capital Market Limited.

key_risks: Non-compliance with IND AS 115 for revenue recognition
Uncertain arbitration claims recognized as income (Rs 70,831.96 Lakhs)
Loan classification and interest accrual issues with related party Ocean Capital Market Limited
Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) related uncertainties
Enforcement Directorate attachment of IDBI bank accounts
facts.related_party_note: All related party transactions are in compliance with Ind-AS 24, Section 188 and SEBI LODR Regulations. Transactions are in ordinary course of business on arm's length basis. Material related party transactions entered during the year. Prior omnibus approval of Audit Committee obtained for foreseen repetitive transactions. No materially significant transactions with potential conflict of interest. Refer Note 60 to Standalone Financial Statements for related party disclosures per Ind AS 24. Form AOC-2 enclosed as Annexure-I.
